name: Yubi College
description: Yubi College is an editorial block theme for sign-language interpreter training colleges and adult-education schools. The home page opens on a split hero: one documentary photograph at the left with a grain-stippled diagonal ribbon over its corner, the statement beside it, and a bordered eight-route link grid as the hero foot. It continues with overhanging caption cards with a gradient corner, a horizontal teaching-week strip, a ribbon band of placement settings, a parallax photo band, graduate rows, a full-width fee sheet and a term-letters sign-up. Source Serif 4 and Nunito Sans, high-key documentary photography, quiet scroll effects.
